dailyTips.title: Water first
dailyTips.message: Drink water in the morning. Apply products to clean, dry skin.

dailyTips.title: Sunscreen daily
dailyTips.message: Apply SPF 30 or higher each morning, even when it is cloudy.

dailyTips.title: Wash gently
dailyTips.message: Use lukewarm water. Pat dry with a clean towel.

dailyTips.title: Night moisturizer
dailyTips.message: Apply moisturizer at night after cleansing.

dailyTips.title: Moisturizer for oily skin
dailyTips.message: Oily skin still needs moisturizer. Use a light gel labeled non-comedogenic.

dailyTips.title: Separate retinol and vitamin C
dailyTips.message: Use vitamin C in the morning and retinol at night.

dailyTips.title: Avoid touching your face
dailyTips.message: Hands carry oil and dirt. Wash hands before applying products.

dailyTips.title: Exfoliation limit
dailyTips.message: Exfoliate 2 to 3 times per week at most. Stop if skin stings.
